description: Genesis, receipt and durable decision boundary controls.

mutants.name: normalized: "invalid hash"
mutants.original: require(isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"(?:0x)?[0-9a-fA-F]{64}", value) is not None, "invalid hash")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "wrong private configuration"
mutants.original: require(genesis["config"] == config and config["chainId"] == 714, "wrong private configuration")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "wrong genesis time"
mutants.original: require(q(genesis["timestamp"]) == GENESIS_TIME, "wrong genesis time")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "wrong genesis block parameters"
mutants.original: require(q(genesis["gasLimit"]) == 40000000 and q(genesis["difficulty"]) == 1, "wrong genesis block parameters")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "wrong private validator genesis"
mutants.original:
require(len(extra) == 166 and extra[:33] == bytes(32) + b"\x01" and extra[33:53] == bytes.fromhex(VALIDATOR[2:]) and
            extra[101:] == bytes(65) and extra[53:101] != bytes(48), "wrong private validator genesis")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "incoherent current fork schedule"
mutants.original: require(all(config[key] == GENESIS_TIME + 6 for key in CURRENT_TIMES), "incoherent current fork schedule")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "wrong warmup or future fork"
mutants.original:
require(config["jennerTime"] == GENESIS_TIME + 864000 and config["keplerTime"] == config["shanghaiTime"] == 0,
            "wrong warmup or future fork")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "unexpected genesis account set"
mutants.original: require(set(genesis["alloc"]) == expected_allocations, "unexpected genesis account set")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "modern contract bytecode differs"
mutants.original: require(actual == row["bytecode_sha256"], "modern contract bytecode differs")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "unexpected preinitialized system state"
mutants.original: require(q(account["balance"]) == 0 and not account.get("storage"), "unexpected preinitialized system state")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "unexpected system genesis nonce"
mutants.original: require(q(account.get("nonce", 0)) == 0, "unexpected system genesis nonce")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "unexpected private genesis allocation"
mutants.original:
require(q(account["balance"]) == balance and q(account.get("nonce", 0)) == 0 and not account.get("storage") and
                account.get("code", "").removeprefix("0x") == code, "unexpected private genesis allocation")

mutants.name: check_genesis: "delayed block fork"
mutants.original: require(value == 0, "delayed block fork")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong captured head"
mutants.original:
require(bridge["mode"] == "LIVE" and bridge["head_number"] == n and
            bridge["head_hash"] == normalized(blocks[-1]["hash"]), "wrong captured head")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong observation frontier"
mutants.original: require(bridge["counters"] == [n, n] and bridge["open_observations"] == [], "wrong observation frontier")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong admission frontier"
mutants.original:
require(bridge["admission_records"] == {"counter": {"next": n}, "lowwater": {"sequence": n}, "purged": {"sequence": n}},
            "wrong admission frontier")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong decision frontier"
mutants.original: require(set(records) == expected_keys and records["counter"] == {"next": n}, "wrong decision frontier")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong delivery obligations"
mutants.original: require(bridge["obligations"] == expected_obligations, "wrong delivery obligations")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong intent schema"
mutants.original: require(set(intent) == {"native_store_id", "producer", "sequence", "kind", "old_head", "new_head", "members", "evidence_digest", "events", "digest"}, "wrong intent schema")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong intent identity"
mutants.original:
require(intent["native_store_id"] == "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef" and intent["producer"] == "bsc-probe.run-1" and
                type(intent["sequence"]) is int and intent["sequence"] == index and intent["kind"] == "IMPORT" and intent["events"] is True,
                "wrong intent identity")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong decision heads"
mutants.original: require(intent["old_head"] == previous and intent["new_head"] == head, "wrong decision heads")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong member count"
mutants.original: require(len(intent["members"]) == 1, "wrong member count")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong capture member"
mutants.original:
require(set(member) == {"observation", "block", "exec_ready_digest", "child_root"} and
                member["observation"] == f"bsc-probe.run-1.{index:016x}" and member["block"] == head["hash"] and
                member["child_root"] == normalized(block["root"]), "wrong capture member")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong intent digest"
mutants.original: require(intent["digest"] == encoding.intent_digest(intent), "wrong intent digest")

mutants.name: check_bridge: "wrong decided record"
mutants.original:
require(decided == {"sequence": index, "intent_digest": intent["digest"], "delivery": "BATCH",
                            "digest": encoding.decided_digest(intent["digest"], "BATCH")}, "wrong decided record")

mutants.name: check_receipt: "stored receipt differs"
mutants.original: require(raw == bytes.fromhex(row["observed_receipt_wire"]), "stored receipt differs")

mutants.name: check_receipt: "receipt arity differs"
mutants.original: require(len(fields) == 4, "receipt arity differs")
mutants.equivalent: Removing the explicit len(fields)==4 check cannot change the verdict: the immediately following mandatory four-target tuple unpack raises ValueError for every other cardinality. The top-level judge catches ValueError. This relies on keeping that unpack unchanged; error wording may differ.

mutants.name: check_receipt: "receipt gas/status differs"
mutants.original:
require(wire.integer(status) == q(receipt["status"]) and wire.integer(cumulative) == q(receipt["cumulativeGasUsed"]) and
            wire.integer(cumulative) - prior_gas == q(receipt["gasUsed"]), "receipt gas/status differs")

mutants.name: check_receipt: "receipt bloom differs"
mutants.original: require(len(bloom) == 256 and "0x" + bloom.hex() == receipt["logsBloom"], "receipt bloom differs")

mutants.name: check_receipt: "receipt log count differs"
mutants.original: require(isinstance(logs, list) and len(logs) == len(observed_logs), "receipt log count differs")

mutants.name: check_receipt: "receipt block context differs"
mutants.original:
require(q(receipt["transactionIndex"]) == transaction_index and q(receipt["blockNumber"]) == block["number"] and
            normalized(receipt["blockHash"]) == normalized(block["hash"]), "receipt block context differs")

mutants.name: check_receipt: "receipt envelope type differs"
mutants.original: require(raw[0] == kind, "receipt envelope type differs")

mutants.name: check_receipt: "invalid receipt log"
mutants.original: require(isinstance(encoded, list) and len(encoded) == 3 and isinstance(encoded[1], list), "invalid receipt log")

mutants.name: check_receipt: "receipt log differs"
mutants.original:
require(wire.address(address) == actual["address"] and all(isinstance(topic, bytes) and len(topic) == 32 for topic in topics) and
                ["0x" + topic.hex() for topic in topics] == actual["topics"] and "0x" + data.hex() == actual["data"], "receipt log differs")
